VILLAFUERTES have a generational political history with the 1942-1943 governorship of Mariano Enciso Villafuerte, then by his son Luis Robredo Villafuerte Sr. who was elected governor from 1988 to 1992, from 1995 to 2004, and serving also as house representative in 2004-2013, when his son Luis Raymond (LRay) Favis Villafuerte Jr. took over. Then, in 2013, LRay’s son Miguel Luis Reyes Villafuerte defeated his grandfather for the governorship and his other son Vicenzo Renato Luigi Reyes Villafuerte took over as the governor from 2022 to 2025.

At the provincial level, the Dy and Albano families continue to hold key positions. Governor Rodolfo “Rodito” Albano III, brother of Representative Tonypet Albano, previously served as vice governor.
